acceptance.basis: Unchanged engineering completeness/coverage/ATE/RPE limits from the previous plane study. Fixed before first image-tracking/PnP fitting; not publisher accuracy requirements or physical calibration guarantees.

calibration.axes: x right, y down, z forward
calibration.basis: Publisher recommends ROS default intrinsics without undistortion for pre-registered PNG depth. Depth is already rescaled and expressed in RGB optical coordinates; apply no extra correction or IR-to-RGB transform. This is the recommended approximation, not newly measured calibration.

dense_fitting_preprocessing.depth_missing: original raw depth validity; no neighborhood expansion

intensity_normalization.admission: minimum correspondence count; finite positive means and gains
intensity_normalization.correspondence: original fitting depth; native bilinear target depth and filtered gray; initial pose
intensity_normalization.ordering: full-resolution row-major accumulation once before pyramid construction

dense_support_policy: Minimum count and a nonsingular system for initial/intermediate hypotheses; the unchanged 0.5 full-resolution correspondence fraction applies to the returned pose. The independent full-cloud support and complete trajectory accuracy gates are unchanged.
generation: All original adjacent RGB-D frames; Gaussian3 gray and original fitting depth, normalized once from the initial native full-resolution correspondence means to 0.5 independently in each gray image, without clipping. Identity then the preceding returned relative increment. No reference, rescale, retry, selection or loss reset.
native_refinement_policy: Only explicit initial-correspondence intensity scaling changes from the gray-only control. Require the existing minimum count and finite positive means/gains before mutation. Ordered streaming mean accumulation owns no pixel-sized buffer; independent scaling shares the bounded CPU pool. Preserve original raw final statistics, depth validity, camera, pyramid, derivatives, solver and all gates.
scope: Prospective component comparison on two observed development scenes after preserving complete gray-only xyz success and rpy ATE failure. Preserve all controls and failures; freeze both full timelines before either new score. No post-score tuning, held-out, speed, external-estimator equivalence or physical-calibration claim.
